references.text: Aron's holy garments were to pass down to his sons after him, who were to be anointed and consecrated in them.
The description of the holy garments made for Aron, the same garments that are now transferred to Eleazar.
God's command that Aron should be gathered to his fathers on Mount Hor, and that his garments should be passed to Eleazar.
A parallel account of Aron's death on Mount Hor, including his age at the time of his death.
Reference to Aron's death and that his son Eleazar became priest in his place.
Moses is told that he will die on the mountain, just as Aron died on Mount Hor.
Moses is informed that he will be gathered to his fathers, just as Aron was.
The Levitical priesthood was characterized by priests who died and had to be replaced, in contrast to Christ's eternal priesthood.
